resources.name: doc_address_expressions
resources.title: Address expressions and number formats
resources.description: Where Cheat Engine address expressions are accepted, their grammar and pointer notations, and the strict number formats some parameters and outputs use instead.

resources.name: doc_aob_signatures
resources.title: AOB signatures
resources.description: Byte patterns that survive updates: wildcard and masking rules, generating and proving signatures, finding a value's exact bytes, injection scaffolds and repair after an update.

resources.name: doc_auto_assembler
resources.title: Auto Assembler syntax and templates
resources.description: Auto Assembler syntax, commands and directives, how scripts are classified against the gates, what asm_check proves, the AOB injection scaffold, code patches, nearby allocation and the check-apply-verify-release cycle.

resources.name: doc_ce_tutorial
resources.title: Cheat Engine tutorial map
resources.description: The tutorial's steps and gtutorial's levels mapped to techniques, workflows and tools, with the step passwords, addresses verified on the CE 7.7 builds and a safe smoke test for a new setup.

resources.name: doc_cheat_recipes
resources.title: Cheat recipes by goal
resources.description: For each common cheat goal: where games usually store the value, the data and code routes, how to verify the result, the robust form and the scope limits.

resources.name: doc_cheat_tables
resources.title: Address list records and cheat tables
resources.description: Address-list records: types, writing-safe creation, pointer chains and +offset fields, freezing, script records, groups and deletes, loading and saving cheat tables with their switch checks, and robust tables.

resources.name: doc_code_analysis
resources.title: Disassembly and code analysis
resources.description: Reading disassembly, function graphs, dissector references and strings, imports and RIP-relative globals to learn what a value means, where its base comes from and where to patch.

resources.name: doc_configuration
resources.title: Configuration reference
resources.description: Every plugin and gateway setting with its default and bounds: precedence, the capability gates and what each refuses, execution limits, file and table roots, environment variables and log files.

resources.name: doc_connection_troubleshooting
resources.title: Connection setup and troubleshooting
resources.description: Plugin, gateway and AI-client setup, and what to check when instance_list is empty, an instance is unavailable, or a call times out, is busy or is refused by a setting.

resources.name: doc_debugger
resources.title: Debugger methods
resources.description: Debugger interfaces and gates, the four breakpoint slots and methods, find-what-writes captures and data-hit heuristics, traces, registers and stepping, and how to leave the target running.

resources.name: doc_emulators
resources.title: Emulator memory
resources.description: Emulated consoles: finding the guest RAM base, letting Cheat Engine scan mapped memory, big-endian search, read and write, guest versus host addresses and pointers, per-emulator notes and dynarec pitfalls.

resources.name: doc_errors_and_recovery
resources.title: Failure kinds and recovery
resources.description: The error envelope and resource error codes, every failure kind and host effect with its next step, timeouts, stale ids, and releasing or acknowledging owned resources without repeating a side effect.

resources.name: doc_game_engines
resources.title: Game engines and runtimes
resources.description: How to identify a game's engine or runtime and predict how it stores values, with per-engine notes and the cases that are out of scope.

resources.name: doc_getting_started
resources.title: Getting started
resources.description: Start here when new: what the plugin and gateway are, the first calls of a session, the settings that gate features, where the docs and prompts live, scope and consent, and how to release what MCP holds.

resources.name: doc_glossary
resources.title: Glossary
resources.description: Short definitions of Cheat Engine and MCP terms, such as AOB, code cave, pointer chain, host effect and job, each with the tool or workflow that uses it.

resources.name: doc_kernel
resources.title: Kernel access (DBK/DBVM)
resources.description: The DBK driver and DBVM hypervisor tools: why they are usually unavailable, the kernel access switch and its gaps, loading DBVM, physical memory, page watches, hazards and recovery.

resources.name: doc_lua
resources.title: Lua in CheatEngine.Mcp
resources.description: Dedicated tools versus lua_execute: how a chunk runs and fails, how return values map to JSON, main-thread and shared-state rules, why Lua must never bypass a gate, and searching celua.txt with lua_find_api.

resources.name: doc_lua_api
resources.title: Cheat Engine Lua API cheat sheet
resources.description: Cheat Engine 7.7 Lua functions by area for lua_execute chunks: celua.txt signatures, danger tags, source-checked traps (offset order, breakpoint callback returns, readString bytes), the tool to prefer and what to avoid.

resources.name: doc_memory_model
resources.title: Windows process memory
resources.description: Regions, protections, module sections, heaps, stacks and what static means in a Windows process; why a read fails, how to change protection safely, and which tool answers which question about an address.

resources.name: doc_mono_and_dotnet
resources.title: Unity (Mono) and .NET targets
resources.description: Choosing between the Mono and .NET collectors, what mono_attach and the Uses Mono option change, reading classes, fields, statics, instances and methods, and invoking or injecting managed code safely.

resources.name: doc_pointers
resources.title: Pointers and pointer scans
resources.description: Pointer notation and offset order, reading a chain, manual chains from a writer, pointer maps, path searches, rescans and their limits, ranking chains, storing them in records, and fallbacks.

resources.name: doc_safety
resources.title: Safety and responsible use
resources.description: Read before the first change: allowed targets, consent, backups, what the four gates do and do not stop, what MCP tracks and how to undo the rest, and the DBK/DBVM and Windows-protection rules.

resources.name: doc_speedhack
resources.title: Speedhack
resources.description: How the speedhack hooks a game's clocks, its lasting host effects and how to restore normal speed.

resources.name: doc_structures
resources.title: Structures and dissect
resources.description: Structure layouts: finding and identifying a base (RTTI), .NET, Mono, PDB and autoguess sources, reading and retyping fields, recognising common data, comparing instances, rename, C header export and cleanup.

resources.name: doc_tool_map
resources.title: Tool map
resources.description: Every tool by domain with its purpose, the setting (gate) it needs and its dispatch class; the running schema stays the authority for parameters and results.

resources.name: doc_troubleshooting_scans
resources.title: When a scan finds nothing
resources.description: What to try when a value scan finds nothing or too much, or finds a value that reverts, will not freeze or moves: the Cheat Engine settings main inherits, emulator mapped memory and scan refusals.

resources.name: doc_unity_il2cpp
resources.title: Unity IL2CPP targets
resources.description: Detecting IL2CPP, what CE's collector offers there and its host effects, method addresses, object and class layouts, statics, instance scans, offline dump offsets and when to stop.

resources.name: doc_unreal_engine
resources.title: Unreal Engine 4 and 5 targets
resources.description: Unreal Engine 4 and 5: version detection, UE5 doubles, UObject, FName and object-array layouts, and tool recipes that find the name pool, GUObjectArray and GWorld; every offset is unverified per build.

resources.name: doc_value_scans
resources.title: Value scan strategy
resources.description: Main versus named scanners, first and next scan comparisons, float precision and rounding, signed compares, narrowing, snapshots and sampling, one-shot value search, and verifying candidates.

resources.name: doc_value_types
resources.title: Value types and data encodings
resources.description: How the scan, memory and record type vocabularies map, and how games store integers, floats, booleans, pointers, tagged engine values, strings and big-endian emulator data in memory.

resources.name: doc_workflows
resources.title: Workflows and session rules
resources.description: Read first: scope, session start, ids, scanners, jobs, cleanup, gates, errors, live resources and the index of guided workflows.

resources.name: doc_x64_injection
resources.title: x64 code injection essentials
resources.description: Registers, calling convention, flags, SSE floats, jcc encodings and same-length branch patches, jump sizes and nearby allocation, RIP-relative operands and whole-instruction patching for code injected into a game's function.

resources.name: instance_debugger
resources.title: Debugger status
resources.description: Cheat Engine's debugger state: whether a debugger is attached and whether the target is broken, proven by its context. Its JSON is the structured result of debugger_get_status.

resources.name: instance_jobs
resources.title: Retained jobs
resources.description: The running, stopping and completed jobs of this activation, kept until their TTL ends. Its JSON is the structured result of runtime_list_jobs.

resources.name: instance_patches
resources.title: Auto Assembler patches
resources.description: The Auto Assembler patches this activation applied and still retains, which block a target change until released; read without any Cheat Engine call. Its JSON is the structured result of asm_list_patches.

resources.name: instance_pointer_maps
resources.title: Pointer maps
resources.description: The pointer maps of this activation with their capture progress, oldest first, read without any Cheat Engine call. Its JSON is the structured result of pointer_list_maps.

resources.name: instance_pointer_scans
resources.title: Pointer scans
resources.description: The pointer scans of this activation with their search progress and counts, oldest first, read without any Cheat Engine call. Its JSON is the structured result of pointer_list_scans.

resources.name: instance_process
resources.title: Current process
resources.description: The process currently selected in this Cheat Engine instance; isOpen=false is a normal unattached state. Its JSON is the structured result of process_get_current.

resources.name: instance_resources
resources.title: Retained resources
resources.description: The activation-owned resources and orphaned Lua state that still hold Cheat Engine state and block a target change. Its JSON is the structured result of runtime_list_resources; release them with runtime_release_resources.

resources.name: instance_runtime
resources.title: Runtime overview
resources.description: The runtime overview of this Cheat Engine instance: host capabilities, the Mcp:Enable* gates (runtime.gates), the current target and the retained resource and job counts. Its JSON is the structured result of runtime_get_overview.

resources.name: instance_scanners
resources.title: Scanners
resources.description: The state of main, Cheat Engine's visible scanner, and of every independent scanner of this activation. Its JSON is the structured result of scan_list_scanners.

resources.name: instance_speedhack
resources.title: Speedhack state
resources.description: Cheat Engine's last configured speedhack multiplier and whether its hook symbol exists; a speed other than 1 is a lasting host effect. Its JSON is the structured result of speedhack_get_state.

resources.name: instance_threads
resources.title: Target threads
resources.description: Up to 4096 thread ids of the attached target, marked truncated when Cheat Engine reports more. Its JSON is the structured result of process_list_threads.

resourceTemplates.name: doc_workflow
resourceTemplates.title: Guided workflow body
resourceTemplates.description: The steps, decisions, pitfalls and report format of one guided workflow; the prompt of the same name (with underscores) embeds this text.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_breakpoints
resourceTemplates.title: Debugger breakpoints
resourceTemplates.description: The breakpoint addresses Cheat Engine reports, marking those this activation owns: 256 by default or ?limit=.. from 1 to 1024. Its JSON is the structured result of debugger_list_breakpoints.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_disassembly
resourceTemplates.title: Disassembly
resourceTemplates.description: The instructions of the attached target from one address forward: 20 by default or ?count=.. from 1 to 1024, with their bytes. The address is an address or Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1C0, percent-encoded where it contains /, ?, # or &. Its JSON is the structured result of code_disassemble; use that tool to include preceding instructions.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_memory
resourceTemplates.title: Memory bytes
resourceTemplates.description: The bytes at one address of the attached target, as spaced hexadecimal: valueType bytes, 256 bytes by default or ?size=.. from 1 to 16384. The address is an address or Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1C, percent-encoded where it contains /, ?, # or &. Its JSON is the structured result of memory_read; use that tool for typed values and strings.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_module
resourceTemplates.title: Module details
resourceTemplates.description: One module of the attached target, by name such as game.exe or by an address expression inside it (percent-encoded): base, size, path, sections and PE header fields, whose time stamp identifies the build. Its JSON is the structured result of module_get.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_module_exports
resourceTemplates.title: Module exports
resourceTemplates.description: A page of one module's exports parsed from its export directory: 200 from offset 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 1000). Its JSON is the structured result of module_list_exports; use that tool to filter by name.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_modules
resourceTemplates.title: Loaded modules
resourceTemplates.description: A page of the modules loaded in the attached target: 200 from offset 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 1000). Its JSON is the structured result of module_list; use that tool to filter by name or read another process.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_pointer_paths
resourceTemplates.title: Pointer paths
resourceTemplates.description: A page of the stored paths of one pointer scan, named in the percent-encoded path, fewest levels first: 100 from offset 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 500); read without any Cheat Engine call. Its JSON is the structured result of pointer_list_paths; use that tool for another order or a module filter.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_record
resourceTemplates.title: Address record
resourceTemplates.description: One address-list record by its current id, a non-negative decimal integer from records or a record tool. Ids expire when a table loads. Its JSON is the structured result of record_get for that one id.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_records
resourceTemplates.title: Address records
resourceTemplates.description: A page of the top-level address-list records in this Cheat Engine instance: 100 from offset 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 1000). Its JSON is the structured result of record_list.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_regions
resourceTemplates.title: Memory regions
resourceTemplates.description: A page of the attached target's committed memory regions in address order: 100 from offset 0 by default (fewer than the tool's 500), or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 2000). Its JSON is the structured result of memory_list_regions; use that tool to filter by range, module, state, backing or protection.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_scanner
resourceTemplates.title: Scanner status
resourceTemplates.description: The state of one scanner: main or the percent-encoded name of an independent scanner. Its JSON is the structured result of scan_get_status.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_structure
resourceTemplates.title: Structure definition
resourceTemplates.description: One structure by its case-sensitive, percent-encoded name, with a page of its elements ordered by offset: 256 from index 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 1024), in the concise format. Its JSON is the structured result of structure_get; use that tool for the detailed format.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_structures
resourceTemplates.title: Structures
resourceTemplates.description: A page of Cheat Engine's Structure Dissect definitions: 100 from offset 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 1000). Its JSON is the structured result of structure_list; use that tool to filter by name.

resourceTemplates.name: instance_symbols
resourceTemplates.title: Registered symbols
resourceTemplates.description: A page of the symbols registered in Cheat Engine, with ownedByMcp on those this activation can unregister: 200 from offset 0 by default, or ?offset=..&limit=.. in that order (limit 1 to 1000); every read copies up to 8192 symbols. Its JSON is the structured result of symbol_list_registered; use that tool to filter by name.
